div.div: Consequence (I-02). After a semantic_issue sends a run to repair, the new attempt reaches narrate with the old attempt's audit still in state. If that report had any drop_reasons or missing_assumptions, the first narration of the new result is treated as a rewrite (rung bumped, trace says 'rewritten', narration_retries = 1), and the new result's own audit can then send nothing back: dropped claims are dropped on the first pass. Spec 7.3 rule 4 says 'once'; the code implements once per run, not once per attempt.

text.tspan: Consequence (I-02). After a semantic_issue sends a run to repair, the new attempt reaches narrate with the old attempt's audit still in state. If that report had any drop_reasons or missing_assumptions, the first narration of the new result is treated as a rewrite (rung bumped, trace says 'rewritten', narration_retries = 1), and the new
result's own audit can then send nothing back: dropped claims are dropped on the first pass. Spec 7.3 rule 4 says 'once'; the code implements once per run, not once per attempt.
